easy: Helping or going along with someone doing something wrong.

ex.en: By keeping quiet, he was complicit in hiding the broken vase.
ex.ko: 입을 다물고 있었으니 그도 깨진 꽃병을 숨기는 데 가담한 셈이었다.

easy: A liquid or gas used to keep a machine from getting too hot.

ex.en: Dad added coolant to the car so the engine wouldn't overheat.
ex.ko: 아빠는 엔진이 너무 뜨거워지지 않게 차에 냉각수를 넣었다.

easy: To work against something to weaken or stop it.

ex.en: Drinking water helps counteract the heat on a sunny day.
ex.ko: 물을 마시면 햇볕이 쨍쨍한 날 더위를 이기는 데 도움이 된다.

easy: The time when a person tries to win someone's love, hoping to marry.

ex.en: Grandpa told us about his courtship of Grandma, with letters and flowers.
ex.ko: 할아버지는 편지와 꽃으로 할머니에게 구애하셨던 이야기를 해 주셨다.

easy: To push too many things into a small space.

ex.en: I crammed all my clothes into one small suitcase.
ex.ko: 나는 옷을 전부 작은 가방 하나에 쑤셔 넣었다.

easy: Very cowardly; very afraid to be brave.

ex.en: The craven knight ran away from the little dragon.
ex.ko: 비겁한 기사는 작은 용을 보고 도망쳤다.

easy: A very big coward.

ex.en: Only a craven would leave a friend in trouble.
ex.ko: 겁쟁이만이 곤경에 처한 친구를 두고 떠날 것이다.

easy: Making someone very weak and tired.

ex.en: The flu was debilitating, and I stayed in bed for a week.
ex.ko: 독감 때문에 몸이 너무 약해져서 일주일 동안 누워 있었다.

easy: To make something stronger or more intense.

ex.en: The scary music heightened the suspense in the movie.
ex.ko: 무서운 음악이 영화의 긴장감을 더 높였다.

easy: A time when business gets worse and people buy less.

ex.en: During the downturn, many shops closed.
ex.ko: 경기가 나빠진 동안 많은 가게가 문을 닫았다.

easy: About an imagined future world that is very unfair and unhappy.

ex.en: The book is set in a dystopian city where kids cannot play outside.
ex.ko: 그 책은 아이들이 밖에서 놀 수 없는 암울한 미래 도시가 배경이다.

easy: By using electricity.

ex.en: The gate opens electrically when you press the button.
ex.ko: 버튼을 누르면 문이 전기로 열린다.

easy: A small area where people with a different culture live, surrounded by a larger area.

ex.en: The city has a Korean enclave with many Korean stores.
ex.ko: 그 도시에는 한국 가게가 많은 한인 거주 지역이 있다.

easy: A group of people who follow and help an important person.

ex.en: The pop star walked in with her whole entourage.
ex.ko: 그 팝 스타는 수행원들을 모두 거느리고 들어왔다.

easy: A long period of time known for something special.

ex.en: The invention of the computer began a new epoch.
ex.ko: 컴퓨터의 발명으로 새로운 시대가 시작되었다.

easy: To make something sound bigger or better than it really is.

ex.en: He exaggerated when he said the fish was as big as a car.
ex.ko: 그가 물고기가 자동차만 하다고 한 건 과장이었다.

easy: In baseball, a player on the team that is not batting, who tries to catch the ball.

ex.en: The fielder dove and caught the ball before it hit the grass.
ex.ko: 야수가 몸을 날려 공이 잔디에 닿기 전에 잡았다.

easy: In terms of how something works.

ex.en: The two phones look different but are functionally the same.
ex.ko: 두 휴대폰은 생김새는 달라도 기능적으로는 똑같다.

easy: A look with your mouth hanging open because you are amazed.

ex.en: She stared at the giant cake with a gape.
ex.ko: 그녀는 거대한 케이크를 입을 딱 벌리고 쳐다보았다.

easy: To stare with your mouth open because you are amazed.

ex.en: We gaped at the huge whale jumping out of the water.
ex.ko: 우리는 물 밖으로 뛰어오르는 거대한 고래를 입을 딱 벌리고 바라보았다.

easy: The rich, powerful people at the top of a society.

ex.en: In the old days, the gentry lived in big houses with servants.
ex.ko: 옛날에 상류층은 하인을 둔 큰 집에서 살았다.

easy: About the group of languages that includes German and English.

ex.en: English has many Germanic words, like "house" and "hand."
ex.ko: 영어에는 "house"나 "hand" 같은 게르만어 단어가 많다.

easy: A family of languages that includes English, German, Dutch, and Swedish.

ex.en: English and German both come from Germanic.
ex.ko: 영어와 독일어는 둘 다 게르만어에서 나왔다.

easy: Putting a rule, tax, or burden on people.

ex.en: The imposition of a new tax made bread cost more.
ex.ko: 새로운 세금이 부과되어 빵값이 올랐다.

easy: Letting yourself have whatever you want, even when you shouldn't.

ex.en: Eating three desserts was pure indulgence.
ex.ko: 디저트를 세 개나 먹은 건 순전히 욕심이었다.

easy: A strong boat on a ship, used to save people if the ship sinks.

ex.en: The passengers climbed into the lifeboats as the ship sank.
ex.ko: 배가 가라앉자 승객들은 구명보트에 올라탔다.

easy: Lasting for a long time.

ex.en: Our two families have a longstanding friendship.
ex.ko: 우리 두 가족은 오랜 우정을 이어 오고 있다.

easy: About mammals, animals with fur that feed their babies milk.

ex.en: Whales have a mammalian body, so they breathe air.
ex.ko: 고래는 포유류의 몸을 가져서 공기로 숨을 쉰다.

easy: A warm-blooded animal with hair or fur whose babies drink milk from their mother.

ex.en: A bat is the only mammalian that can truly fly.
ex.ko: 박쥐는 진짜로 날 수 있는 유일한 포유동물이다.

easy: In an amazing way, like a miracle.

ex.en: Miraculously, the kitten survived the fall without a scratch.
ex.ko: 기적적으로 아기 고양이는 떨어지고도 상처 하나 없었다.

easy: Making something by pouring a liquid into a shaped container and letting it harden.

ex.en: The molding of chocolate bunnies happens at the candy factory.
ex.ko: 초콜릿 토끼는 사탕 공장에서 틀로 찍어 만든다.

easy: A small motorcycle with small wheels.

ex.en: My uncle rode his motorbike down the country road.
ex.ko: 삼촌이 시골길을 따라 소형 오토바이를 탔다.

easy: To ride a motorcycle.

ex.en: They motorbiked across the island to see the beaches.
ex.ko: 그들은 해변을 보러 오토바이를 타고 섬을 가로질렀다.

easy: Not real; not existing at all.

ex.en: Unicorns are nonexistent, but I still love drawing them.
ex.ko: 유니콘은 존재하지 않지만 나는 그래도 유니콘 그리기를 좋아한다.

easy: Being famous for something bad.

ex.en: The pirate gained notoriety for stealing gold from ships.
ex.ko: 그 해적은 배에서 금을 훔치는 것으로 악명을 떨쳤다.

easy: Tasting like nuts.

ex.en: This bread has a nutty flavor from the seeds.
ex.ko: 이 빵은 씨앗 덕분에 고소한 맛이 난다.

easy: Full of fancy words or decorations.

ex.en: The prince gave an ornate speech full of long, fancy words.
ex.ko: 왕자는 길고 화려한 말로 가득 찬 연설을 했다.

easy: To make something keep going for a long time.

ex.en: Movies perpetuate the myth that goldfish forget everything in three seconds.
ex.ko: 영화들은 금붕어가 3초 만에 모든 것을 잊는다는 잘못된 이야기를 계속 퍼뜨린다.

easy: Telling what will happen in the future, as if by magic.

ex.en: Her dream turned out to be prophetic when it snowed the next day.
ex.ko: 다음 날 정말 눈이 오자 그녀의 꿈은 예언이었던 셈이 되었다.

easy: Something done on purpose to make someone angry.

ex.en: Poking your sister is a provocation, so stop it.
ex.ko: 동생을 쿡쿡 찌르는 건 화나게 하는 짓이니 그만해.

easy: To make something clean by taking out dirty or harmful parts.

ex.en: We boiled the water to purify it on the camping trip.
ex.ko: 캠핑 갔을 때 우리는 물을 끓여서 깨끗하게 만들었다.

easy: The part of medicine that uses X-rays and scans to look inside the body.

ex.en: My arm X-ray was checked by a doctor in radiology.
ex.ko: 내 팔 엑스레이는 영상의학과 의사가 확인했다.

easy: A game where people buy tickets and winners are picked to get prizes.

ex.en: I won a bike in the school raffle!
ex.ko: 나는 학교 경품 추첨에서 자전거를 받았어!

easy: To give away a prize by drawing tickets.

ex.en: The school raffled off a basket of toys.
ex.ko: 학교는 장난감 바구니를 경품으로 추첨했다.

easy: To join a group again.

ex.en: After my cold, I rejoined the soccer team.
ex.ko: 감기가 나은 뒤 나는 축구팀에 다시 합류했다.

easy: A time when an illness gets better or calms down.

ex.en: Grandma's illness is in remission, and she feels much better.
ex.ko: 할머니의 병이 차도를 보여서 할머니는 훨씬 좋아지셨다.

easy: Feeling truly sorry for something wrong you did.

ex.en: He showed repentance by fixing the fence he broke.
ex.ko: 그는 부순 울타리를 고쳐서 뉘우치는 마음을 보여 주었다.

easy: To make a deep sound that fills a space and keeps ringing.

ex.en: The church bell resonated across the valley.
ex.ko: 교회 종소리가 골짜기 너머로 울려 퍼졌다.

easy: Money paid to make up for damage or loss.

ex.en: The boy paid restitution for the window he broke with his ball.
ex.ko: 소년은 공으로 깬 창문값을 배상했다.

easy: An important religious ceremony in Christian churches, like baptism.

ex.en: Baptism is a sacrament in many churches.
ex.ko: 세례는 많은 교회에서 성사로 여겨진다.

easy: About school or studying.

ex.en: The scholastic year starts in September.
ex.ko: 학년은 9월에 시작한다.

easy: A whip used long ago to punish people.

ex.en: The museum showed a leather scourge from the Middle Ages.
ex.ko: 박물관에는 중세 시대의 가죽 채찍이 전시되어 있었다.

easy: All the signs in a place, like store signs and posters.

ex.en: New signage shows the way to the zoo's penguin house.
ex.ko: 새 표지판이 동물원 펭귄관 가는 길을 알려 준다.

easy: The waste stuff left over when metal is melted down.

ex.en: Workers scraped the slag off the top of the hot metal.
ex.ko: 작업자들이 뜨거운 금속 위에 뜬 찌꺼기를 걷어 냈다.

easy: A sudden, loud burst of air out of your nose and mouth.

ex.en: Her sneeze was so loud that the cat jumped.
ex.ko: 그녀의 재채기 소리가 너무 커서 고양이가 펄쩍 뛰었다.

easy: To suddenly blow air out of your nose and mouth when it tickles.

ex.en: Pepper always makes me sneeze.
ex.ko: 후추를 맡으면 나는 늘 재채기가 난다.

easy: The main kind of money used in Uzbekistan.

ex.en: The melon at the market cost a few thousand som.
ex.ko: 시장의 멜론은 몇천 숨이었다.

easy: A runner who races short distances very fast.

ex.en: The sprinter crossed the finish line in ten seconds.
ex.ko: 단거리 선수가 10초 만에 결승선을 통과했다.

easy: A time when nothing grows, moves, or gets better.

ex.en: After years of stagnation, the town got a new factory and new jobs.
ex.ko: 여러 해 침체를 겪은 뒤 마을에 새 공장과 일자리가 생겼다.

easy: In terms of how something is built.

ex.en: The old bridge is structurally strong, even though it looks rusty.
ex.ko: 그 오래된 다리는 녹슬어 보여도 구조적으로는 튼튼하다.

easy: A chemical made from sulfuric acid, found in many minerals.

ex.en: Epsom salt is a kind of sulfate used in bath water.
ex.ko: 엡섬 소금은 목욕물에 넣는 황산염의 한 종류이다.

easy: A warm, soft cotton top with long sleeves.

ex.en: I wore my soft gray sweatshirt to soccer practice.
ex.ko: 나는 축구 연습에 부드러운 회색 맨투맨 티를 입고 갔다.

easy: A straight line that touches a curve at just one point.

ex.en: Draw a tangent that just touches the edge of the circle.
ex.ko: 원의 가장자리에 딱 한 점만 닿는 접선을 그려라.

easy: A shape like a donut or an inner tube.

ex.en: A donut is shaped like a torus.
ex.ko: 도넛은 토러스 모양이다.

easy: To find out something hidden by searching.

ex.en: The detective unearthed the secret plan.
ex.ko: 탐정은 비밀 계획을 밝혀냈다.

easy: In the same way all over; evenly.

ex.en: Spread the frosting uniformly over the cake.
ex.ko: 케이크 위에 크림을 고르게 펴 발라라.

easy: Complete, with no limits.

ex.en: The show was an unqualified success, and every seat was full.
ex.ko: 공연은 대성공이었고 모든 좌석이 꽉 찼다.

easy: To pull apart the threads of something knitted or tangled.

ex.en: The kitten unraveled my scarf by pulling on the yarn.
ex.ko: 아기 고양이가 털실을 잡아당겨 내 목도리를 다 풀어 버렸다.

easy: In different ways.

ex.en: The pet is variously called Fluffy, Fluff, or Fluffball.
ex.ko: 그 애완동물은 플러피, 플러프, 플러프볼 등 여러 이름으로 불린다.

easy: Empty land where nobody lives and nothing can be grown.

ex.en: The desert was a dry wasteland of rocks and sand.
ex.ko: 그 사막은 바위와 모래뿐인 메마른 황무지였다.

easy: A person or group that watches to stop cheating, stealing, or waste.

ex.en: The watchdog group checks that toys are safe for kids.
ex.ko: 그 감시 단체는 장난감이 아이들에게 안전한지 확인한다.

easy: A member of a large group of people who live in South Africa.

ex.en: The Zulu dancers stomped and sang at the festival.
ex.ko: 줄루족 무용수들이 축제에서 발을 구르며 노래했다.

easy: Choosing not to do or have something, especially not drinking alcohol.

ex.en: Grandpa's doctor told him abstinence from soda would help his health.
ex.ko: 의사는 할아버지께 탄산음료를 끊으면 건강에 좋을 거라고 했다.

easy: In terms of school learning and grades.

ex.en: Academically, she is one of the best students in her class.
ex.ko: 학업 면에서 그녀는 반에서 가장 뛰어난 학생 중 하나이다.
